summary: [spec fidelity] batch preflight still lets CONFIG_MISSING answer first in a directory with no repository when item 0 is valid: `export --input '[{"kind":"change"},{"kind":"change","before":"2026-01-02","after":"2026-02-01"}]'`, the same with `limit` 0 or a bad calendar date, `artifacts store --input '[{},{"maxArtifactMib":0}]'`, `ingest records` and `ingest sessions` with `intervalSecs` -1 all answer exit 2 CONFIG_MISSING at --repo instead of the item's fault at /items/1/...; in a repository every one of them is refused in preflight with the item's own code and nothing written, and the batches of finding add/close, divergence add/defer, evidence add, review change, change new, init, skills install and gate install-hooks answer the fault in both places; spec 11.7 and 11.11 make steps 1-6 independent of state; exit 2 and nothing written either way; blast radius: the four commands whose item 0 can be `{}` and that need a configured repository
